events.subtitle: 50th Anniversary Live — Playing Piano & Singing 2027

priority_review.rationale: The scarcity is performance-specific: Akiko Yano's 50th-anniversary piano-and-voice concert brings Pat Metheny into a first stage collaboration after decades of exchange through recordings and compositions, and adds Hayato Sumino as a cross-generational piano partner. Official artist and promoter sources announce only Tokyo and Osaka and describe the Yano/Metheny encounter as a first-and-last stage collaboration. A+ was explicitly challenged and judged insufficient because missing the exact anniversary configuration would mean losing a documented two-city collaboration unlikely to recur. S+ would overstate the evidence because the same artists perform again in Osaka two days later and the engagement is not announced as a farewell or final Yano performance.

events.category: Japanese master / 50th anniversary / first Yano-Metheny stage collaboration
events.factual_description: Akiko Yano's 50th Anniversary Live — Playing Piano & Singing 2027 takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at Tokyo International Forum Hall A. Doors open at 17:30 and the concert begins at 18:30. Yano performs with special guests Hayato Sumino and Pat Metheny. Official sources frame the program around Yano's piano-and-voice origin after the 1976 debut Japanese Girl and describe this as the first stage collaboration between Yano and Metheny, whose recorded relationship includes Metheny's composition Prayer and guitar appearances on several Yano recordings, plus Yano's participation in Metheny's Secret Story. The announced ticket categories are ¥23,000 SS, ¥19,000 S and ¥5,500 rear seating. The exact authorized ePlus destination is announced for the official advance beginning November 18 and general sale beginning January 11; the currently open fan-club presale is separately limited to members.

en.why_it_matters: Yano is using the fiftieth anniversary to return to piano and voice, then opening that language to two relationships from different generations. Metheny already runs through her recorded history as composer and guitarist, but this is their first stage collaboration; Sumino brings a contemporary pianist's ear into a concert rooted in the 1976 Japanese Girl beginning. The value is the encounter, not an anniversary label pasted onto a standard set.
en.trip_verdict: Protect March 6 if Tokyo is reachable. Only Tokyo and Osaka are announced for this three-person anniversary configuration, so waiting for another equivalent date would be a real gamble.

es.why_it_matters: Yano usa el cincuentenario para volver al piano y la voz y abrir ese lenguaje a dos relaciones de generaciones distintas. Metheny ya atraviesa su historia discográfica como compositor y guitarrista, pero ésta es su primera colaboración en escena; Sumino mete el oído de un pianista contemporáneo en un concierto que vuelve al punto de partida de Japanese Girl en 1976. El valor está en el encuentro, no en pegarle una etiqueta de aniversario a un set convencional.
es.trip_verdict: Protegería el 6 de marzo si Tokio está al alcance. Sólo están anunciadas Tokio y Osaka para esta formación de aniversario; esperar otra fecha equivalente sería una apuesta real.
